scope: UI design, configuration workflows, required application wiring and isolated acceptance; not live authorization
frontend: FastAPI/Jinja2 autoescaped HTML + locally pinned ES modules, Chart.js and Tabulator; no React/Dash/admin framework rewrite
private_origin: separate restricted origin for private trading; separate auth and credentials; no private-execution API proxy in commercial service
commercial_origin: public /; identity /auth; customer /app; staff /ops with independent action scopes
api_prefix: Retain actual /api/v1/me and /api/v1/billing/webhook/stripe. New commercial routes use /api/v1, not the old unimplemented /api/commercial/v1 catalog. Update mappings; no duplicate financial command endpoint.
data: Existing private SQLite unchanged; commercial PostgreSQL/RLS reused. UI reads projection services, not direct browser database admin access.
authentication: Commercial BFF maps provider-validated identities to revocable opaque HttpOnly same-origin sessions. No browser localStorage access/refresh tokens. Existing bearer /me clients remain scoped. Private owner session remains separate.
provisioning: Create real empty tables, drafts and query paths locally. No public synthetic portfolios, unapproved claims or fake paid/live success. Isolated test fixtures explicitly allowed.
phasing: Complete UI/service integration before asking for research results. External approval blocks that effect/qualification, not page construction.
signed_effects: Preview, confirm, operation outcome: exact object revision, server identity, expiring scope, current gates and durable idempotency. No financial JS logic.
polling: 10s visible critical view fallback,30s admin table,60s approved public catalog;one outstanding request per resource;abort stale scope;no zero-delay polling.
effect_retry: No automatic POST effect replay. Stable-key operation lookup after uncertain response; server controls recovery.
no_live_change: No change to financial limits, trading policy, source rights, real prices, subscriptions, mandates, payouts, or infrastructure authority by this design task.
charts: Null means unavailable;known zero is0. Pure rendering may convert validated decimal strings to approximate axis coordinates only; financial totals remain server-defined exact strings.
saved_layouts: Role/principal/workspace/environment scoped;visual only. Mandatory identity,origin,fees,drawdown,staleness and urgent safety panels cannot be hidden.
ai: No LLM required. Optional draft research prose has evidence/review. Never compute P&L,grant rights,activate copying or generate fabricated performance via LLM.
